Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Acme Voice builds on-device speech recognition for call centres. We are hiring a senior engineer to own the accuracy roadmap for our streaming recogniser.

What you will do

  • Own the word error rate roadmap for English and Swahili recognition.
  • Design data pipelines that turn call recordings into curated training sets.
  • Optimise inference so a single GPU serves more concurrent voices.
  • Work with product to turn accuracy measurements into customer-facing guarantees.

What we are looking for

The ideal candidate has shipped a speech or language model to production, is comfortable with PyTorch and ONNX, and can explain trade-offs between latency, accuracy and cost to non-specialists.

You will join a team of six engineers and work directly with the founders. We review accuracy weekly, publish internal benchmarks, and treat evaluation data as a product in its own right.

Benefits

Remote-first within East Africa, a learning budget, and four weeks of paid leave. We meet in Nairobi twice a year for a planning week.
